VOID RUNNER - test report

4 test agents played the game on the PC simulator. Each problem shows now and fixed (same scenario, fix applied in a copy). 17 problems after merging duplicates. Nothing is changed in the project yet.

1 HUNTER hits the ship when no lit pixels touch high

The ship's nose sits in the gap of the HUNTER's bottom row and still loses a life.

Cause game.h:205 - the boss uses a box test.
Fix Use the same pixel test as for enemies (spriteTouchesShip with the boss sprite).

HUNTER

2 A hit stops auto-fire and the ship glides while R is held high

After a hit the firing stops and the ship moves on its own although R is still held (the spec says: no gliding while R is held).

Cause player.h:123 - playerHit sets firing = false.
Fix Remove that line.

Hit while holding D + R

3 Enemy bullet starts right next to (or inside) the ship medium

Ship at the top row, an enemy above fires: the bullet appears at the ship's nose and hits 100 ms later, undodgeable. (Found by two testers.)

Cause enemies.h:34 - enemies may shoot from rows 0-9, the ship may fly up to row 9.
Fix Do not shoot when the bullet would start less than 3 rows above the ship.

Weaver above the ship

4 Tapping R ignores the ship's fire rate medium

10 quick taps fire 9 bullets in 1.1 s, holding R only 5. The hangar's fire level means nothing when tapping.

Cause player.h:89 - every press resets nextShot.
Fix Only move nextShot forward; a tap during reload still fires once.

Quick taps

5 Rocks and drones from the bosses sink through the boss medium

WARDEN rocks and VOID KING drones / rock rain spawn above the boss and fall through it, bending its picture; drones shoot from inside the KING.

Cause boss.h:66-67, 165, 168 - spawnFromTable puts them at y = -h above the boss.
Fix New bossDrop(): the helper appears just below the boss.

WARDEN
VOID KING

6 Pickups fall through the WARN sign and merge with it medium

A life / ammo crate dropped just before the boss warning blends into the blinking sign.

Cause game.h:441 - the sign is drawn without a clean background.
Fix Clear the sign's 11x10 area before drawing it.

Phase 3 warning

7 Silence after pausing in WARN, CLEAR (also INTRO, DEAD) medium

Pause and continue during the warning: the siren is gone (up to 3 s of silence). Same for the "clear" tune. (Found by two testers.)

Cause void_runner.ino:58 stops all sound on pause; game.h:58 playStageMusic only restarts WAVES and BOSS music.
Fix playStageMusic also restarts SFX_SIREN in WARNING and SONG_CLEAR in CLEAR.

Buzzer frequencies over time

8 Demo starts too early after key presses on the title medium

Keys pressed on the title do not restart the 20 s timer: the demo started 5.8 s after the last key.

Cause void_runner.ino:188 - counts from when the title opened.
Fix Count from the last key press (titleTouched).

Title screen

9 Two weavers in phase 2 merge into one blob low

Pairs that start 3-4 columns apart zig-zag onto the same pixels.

Cause levels.h:37, 40.
Fix Spawn them further apart (x 2 and 10, x 3 and 11).

Phase 2

10 Player bullets "hit" empty pixels low

A bullet in a gap of the WARDEN vanishes 2 rows below the lit pixel; on drones and rocks 1 row early.

Cause game.h:122-137 - box test instead of sprite pixels.
Fix Test the sprite pixels of both bullet pixels.

11 Screen shake carries into the next game low

Die or get hit, pause, Q, PLAY: the ship jitters during "ZONE 1".

Cause world.h:259 - worldClear does not reset shakeFrames.
Fix shakeFrames = 0 in worldClear().

Next game after a hit

12 Move key held through pause / into a new phase is ignored low

Hold D during pause, continue: the ship does not move.

Cause player.h - moveKey is stale after pause; playerStart clears it.
Fix New playerResume() takes the key that is held now.

After pause

13 Pressing R to continue from pause also fires low

Two bullets instead of none.

Cause player.firing stays true through the pause.
Fix Same playerResume() as 12.

Continue with R

14 A hit enemy is hidden but can still crash into the ship low

The rock is invisible and "hit by rock" comes anyway.

Cause game.h:198 - contactsStep does not skip e.flash.
Fix Skip enemies with flash. Only a partial fix: the rock reappears in the same picture as the crash.

Big rock

15 No B / M confirmation beep during the logo low

The setting changes but you hear nothing.

Cause logo.h:109 - soundRelease cancels the beep in the same frame.
Fix Release only on the frame a crackle ends.

Sound log

16 Engine flames flicker every 20 ms (hangar, title) low

Breaks the "blink at least 100 ms" rule; in Wokwi it only looks like a steady pixel.

Cause screens.h:86, title.h:17 - frameNo & 1.
Fix Use frameNo & 8.

20 frames at 20 ms

17 Test command !1/!2/!3 during the demo low

Starts a game that is still a demo (any key goes back to the title). Test command only.

Cause void_runner.ino:~130 does not clear demoMode.
Fix Clear demoMode and autopilot first.

Demo

Not a bug, but check in VS Code

The logo scrolls "RUNNER" across (SPEC section 7) although text is otherwise never scrolled. Also: 48 of 150 idle/demo test runs stayed in one wave phase for more than 5 min - not investigated.
